title: Excellent tour
text: Our guide was very knowledgeable, patient, and safe. We would definitely recommend this Segway guided tour.
author: Howard_M

title: Amazing experience!
text:
Lautaro was awesome! Lots of information and lots of fun! He was also very cautious and supportive with the Segway, which was appreciated. I was a little nervous of using a Segway, as I have never used one before. He was great at instructing us on how to use it, and I felt safe the entire time.
Taking the Segway also allow us to cover a lot more ground and see a lot more.
He took us to cool spots and give us some time to take in the views, and take pictures.
author: 966maryannh

title: Great guide!!!
text: Amazing! TJ was so friendly and knowledgeable about Granada, the culture, the history, and all the different ways it has survived, plus the significance of its location, and the list just goes on with extraordinary insight into its significance. He was always smiling and willing to accommodate with rests and beautiful viewpoints! I highly recommend!!
author: Deborah_M

title: Highly recommended
text:
Great fun. Very professional company 
One of us was a first timer and was coached and looked after very well
Interesting and informative excursion
author: Dawn_T

title: Amazing morning on the Segway with Marta!
text: We joined the 2-hour Segway tour. Marta was a knowledgeable and engaging guide, entertaining us with her anecdotes on Granada’s history. It was a fun way to explore the Albaicin and Sacromonte areas. Highly recommended!
author: emilyk825

title: Great way to see Granda
text:
We had a great morning dispite the rain, a very friend and knowladgeble guide. Sorry we forgot your name.
Lot of history and amazing view.
author: Christopher_S

title: Fantastic way to see the more remote parts of the city
text: Booked the Segway tour for three of us. Mario, our guide, was wonderful, can't recommend him highly enough! The whole experience was great, booking was straightforward, communication with the company was very good. The tour itself was terrific. Mario was great with my daughter, who hadn't been on a Segway before, and with my father who needed a bit of time to get used to it. Mario's' knowledge of the area was brilliant, and there were just enough stops to be interesting whilst giving us plenty of time on the Segway. Will definitely do this again on our next visit to Granada. Thanks Mario!
author: jaimedD2517YM

title: Segway through Granada
text: It was a fun way to see Granada and get some great views of the city.  Miya (I think her name) was careful to make sure we were safe (there were no problems).  I would highly recommend.
author: Carol_A

title: Great fun way to see chunks of the city without effort
text: After a wobbly 2 minutes practice on the machine, riding it was a breeze. Mia, our guide, took us to a number of interesting places and the Segways made short work of the steep hills. Nb the location given is WRONG. it’s not number 3 or number 11 but is the alley next to the tourist office.
author: Chris_M

title: Segway always!
text:
This is our 3rd city tour on Segway. We loved it as you get to go into streets alleys that you would not see otherwise. Also you get to see more than on foot in less time. Safety is a no. 1 concern then a pleasant tour for clients. 
Our guide Mia was very knowledgeable and with a very positive attitude.
author: CTarTrip
